jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Specialist
jobs.description:
About the role
As a Continuous Improvement Specialist, you will be a hands-on change agent focused on driving operational performance across our manufacturing site. Grounded in Lean Six Sigma foundations (5S, TPM, Visual Management, DMAIC), you will spend time on the shop floor identifying waste, eliminating process variation, and directly impacting key performance metrics (safety, quality, productivity, delivery, cost). You will leverage data, analytical tools, AI and emerging digital solutions to diagnose root causes and coach site teams to build sustainable, self-service problem-solving habits. You will combine analytical experience with practical problem-solving to build intuitive dashboards, facilitate Kaizen events, and champion the Manufacturing Daily Improvement (MDI) process. You will serve as an educator—teaching teams from White Belt fundamentals to A3 execution—to embed a lasting culture of site-wide autonomy and accountability.
Key Responsibilities
Work Location/Status: On-site role based at our Cramlington facility.
- Hands-On Waste & Variation Reduction: Actively engage on the shop floor to map processes, uncover bottlenecks, and eliminate non-value-added activities using Lean / Six Sigma tools to directly improve key operational metrics.

- DMAIC Project Execution & Facilitation: Independently lead and execute productivity improvement projects utilizing the DMAIC framework, and facilitate root-cause problem-solving sessions, A3s, and Kaizen events to drive plant KPIs.

- MDI & ELS Deployment: Support facilitation of the Manufacturing Daily Improvement (MDI) process across the site, supporting cross-functional teams with Enterprise Lean Sigma (ELS) skillsets and disciplines to drive accountability and prioritization.

- Education & White Belt Training: Serve as a site educator by facilitating Lean Six Sigma White Belt training sessions, building foundational capabilities, and embedding a self-service mindset across all shifts and functions.

- Data Visualisation, Analytics & AI Integration: Analyze performance data using BI tools to build/maintain intuitive dashboards, and explore and adopt Gemini AI and digital tools to streamline Lean workflows and reduce administrative waste.
- Required:
- Professional Experience: 3-5 years of professional experience in Lean Six Sigma / Continuous Improvement within a manufacturing environment.

- Education & Certifications: Degree qualified (or equivalent experience) with a solid foundation in Six Sigma and Lean Manufacturing methodologies; Green Belt or Black Belt certification is highly desirable.

- Skills you need to succeed:
- Practical Problem-Solving: Excellent root-cause analysis skills with a pragmatic, hands-on approach to identifying waste, eliminating variation, and solving operational challenges alongside shop-floor teams.

- Data & Analytics Capability: Experience in data analytics with modern BI tools (e.g., Oracle Analytics, IBM Cognos, Power BI, Tableau) and the ability to build and maintain intuitive dashboards.

- Digital Mindset & Leadership: Curiosity and enthusiasm for using Gemini AI (or similar Generative AI platforms) to streamline problem-solving, alongside strong coaching and communication skills to mentor teams and foster cultural accountability.
What we offer
Here's a glimpse of the great benefits you can expect:
- Health & Financial Security : Enjoy Health and Life Insurance, a Cash Health Plan, Pension, and a Bonus. Benefits include a subsidized canteen, access to a discount site, free parking, free electric charging points, and free annual flu vaccinations and visual eye test vouchers.
- Time Off & Flexibility : Benefit from 25 vacation days, plus statutory bank holidays, Parental leave and family-friendly policies, and flexible working arrangements.
- Well-being & Continuous Development : Access an Employee Assistance Program, our comprehensive Wellbeing Policy, and Development Discussions for career growth. Join our Active Sports & Social Club and enjoy annual summer and Christmas events.
- Community Engagement : Opportunities to participate in volunteer activities to support Non-Profit Organizations.
To help us process your application quickly, please upload your CV in either PDF or Word format. We also kindly ask that you submit your resume in the same language as this job posting.

We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. jobs.description:
Are you ready to architect the future of Advanced Manufacturing?
At the Materials Group (MG), we are not just optimizing operations, we are redefining them. We are seeking a visionary and dynamic Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0  to lead our central Enterprise Lean System (ELS) function.
This is a high-impact, regional executive role designed for an operational architect who can bridge the gap between world-class, foundational Lean Six Sigma methodologies and cutting-edge Industry 4.0 technologies (AI, Predictive Analytics, and Cognitive Automation). Based in our Rodange facility, you will hold the keys to regional standardization, capability building, and digital supply chain transformation across Europe.
The Challenge & The Vision
As the Director of Central ELS, you will play two pivotal roles: the Guardian of Standards and the Pioneer of Innovation.
You will lead a high-performing central team to drive continuous improvement, establishing a high-margin production environment. Concurrently, you will orchestrate the transition from manual Lean frameworks to an AI-driven "Lighthouse Factory" footprint, leveraging predictive models, virtual environments, and connected systems.
Key Responsibilities
1. Guardian of Operational & Supply Chain Standards
- Act as the regional "Center as Guardian," serving as the sole architect of operational standards in the Regional Playbook.
- Govern all core manufacturing work standards (5S, Standard Work Audits, Daily Tier Meetings, Kaizen, SMED, TPM, and OEE Tracking/Loss Analysis).
- Establish robust supply chain standards, covering Production Planning Logic, Inventory Buffer Protocols, Freight Spend Governance, and S&OP Integration.
- Govern and standardize Data Science & AI models across the region.

2. Capability Builder & Training Academy Leader
- Standardize regional workforce mindsets and skillsets through a centralized regional training engine.
- Maintain the end-to-end certification pathway for Yellow, Green, and Black Belt mastery, alongside modern Digital Literacy pathways.
- Design functionally deep training curricula and scale execution through "Train-the-Trainer" initiatives with local site leaders.

3. Orchestrator of Strategy Deployment
- Lead the Yearly Strategic Deployment process ensuring 100% functional alignment between Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and IT.
- Utilize the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and key performance metrics to establish regional breakthrough targets.
- Facilitate the collaborative "Catchball" process to negotiate and lock departmental action plans.
- Manage the monthly governance framework for PDCA reviews at executive and functional levels.

4. Pioneer of ELS 4.0 & Digital Twin Innovation
- Drive the shift to automated, AI-driven operations, implementing predictive models that empower local sites to preempt issues.
- Lead shopfloor IoT integration, ensuring machines feed real-time performance data directly into core IT systems.
- Deploy a Regional Control Tower live-dashboard to visualize the entire end-to-end supply chain.
- Deploy advanced solutions for AI-Driven Predictive Quality, Maintenance, Cognitive Automation, and dynamic 3D Digital Twin simulations.

5. Champion of the Hub & Spoke Model
- Serve as the central regional filter and amplifier for operational innovation.
- Capture best-in-class local site innovations directly from the Gemba, codifying validated successes into the "Gold Standard" regional playbook for network-wide deployment.

6. High-Performing Team Leader
- Cultivate an inspiring team culture rooted in high performance, psychological safety, and radical accountability.
- Mentor and coach a dedicated central team, providing clear career development pathways and fostering cross-functional collaboration.
Who You Are
- The Expert: You possess extensive experience leading Lean, Six Sigma, and Continuous Improvement functions on a regional or global scale.
- The Digital Native: You have a proven track record of implementing Industry 4.0 solutions (IoT, Predictive Maintenance, AI, or Digital Twins) within a manufacturing environment.
- The Architect: You excel at designing, documenting, and scaling operational systems and standards from scratch.
- The Communicator: You are an expert at navigating Hoshin Kanri / Strategic Deployment, bringing diverse stakeholders (from the shopfloor to the C-suite) along on the transformation journey.
- The People Developer: You love building capability, leading academies, and mentoring future operational leaders.

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Excellence and S&OP Manager, ASEAN
jobs.description:
ABOUT YOUR ROLE:
As the Supply Chain Excellence & S&OP Manager, you will be the strategic architect of our regional value chain. This is a high-impact, cross-functional leadership role focused on synchronizing demand, supply, and capacity to ensure business agility. You will not only manage the rhythm of our S&OP cycles but also lead the charge in digitalization and end-to-end (E2E) efficiency transformation across the ASEAN region as well as managing the supply to the region.
The ideal candidate is a blend of a master planner, a data scientist, and a change agent.
You will be based in Bangi / Kajang, Malaysia.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE:
1. Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)
- Orchestrate the S&OP Process: Lead monthly regional S&OP meetings, facilitating alignment between Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations.

- Balance Ecosystems: Act as the primary point of contact to balance demand forecasts with supply capabilities and manufacturing capacity.

- Scenario Planning: Develop "What-If" scenarios to mitigate risks and capitalize on market opportunities within the volatile ASEAN landscape.

2. Rough Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP) & Resource Validation
- Demand Validation: Verify RCCP outputs against S&OP demand, ensuring high-accuracy inputs for forecast volumes, UEE, run rates, and planning coefficients.

- Capacity Modeling: Analyze plant/DC constraints and production calendars to generate short-to-long-term capacity projections and identify bottlenecks.

- Scenario Planning: Present Base/Upside/Downside scenarios to S&OP, recommending strategic actions like load shifting, campaign planning, and capacity flexing.

- Operational Governance: Lead RCCP alignment meetings and track Actual vs. Plan performance to optimize utilization, inventory levels, and cost.

- Digital Visibility: Maintain and enhance RCCP dashboards to provide real-time visibility into capacity loading and future risks.

3. Supply Chain Excellence & E2E Efficiency
- Holistic Process Transformation: Identify structural bottlenecks across the E2E value chain (suppliers to final mile). Drive cost-out and efficiency initiatives using a diverse process improvement toolkits.

- Performance Architecture: Design and govern a regional KPI framework focused on "North Star" metrics: Forecast Accuracy, Cost to Serve, Capacity Utilization, OTIF, and Inventory Turns.

- Digitalization & Automation: Lead ASEAN digital roadmap. Partner closely with the Regional Supply Chain teams to automate manual workflows, ensuring seamless tool adoption and shifting the organization toward automated, data-led supply chain.

- Inventory & Working Capital Optimization: Lead Multi-Echelon Inventory Optimization (MEIO) to balance regional stock positioning. Dynamically manage safety stock and lead-time parameters to maximize service levels while minimizing tied-up capital.

- Network Resilience & Agility: Standardize "Best Practice" operating models across ASEAN to enhance regional responsiveness. Leverage digital visibility and data-driven insights to mitigate disruptions, improve agility, and optimize the total Cost-to-Serve across the end-to-end network.

4. Supply Management
- Process and master data: Uphold and oversee the governance of the purchase and supply process & master data across ASEAN

- Purchase and inventory management execution: Lead and optimize the end-to-end execution of purchase and inventory replenishment cycles, ensuring optimal stock levels while maintaining service level

- Distribution strategy: Formulate and execute comprehensive distribution strategies to ensure the achievement of a resilient and optimized distribution network

- Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary liaison between Sales, Finance, and Operations to align supply strategies with business goals and manage relationships with external vendors to ensure service reliability

5. Other Responsibilities
- Strategic Initiatives: Drive departmental goals by spearheading projects in standardization, digitalization, and process optimization to continuously elevate regional supply chain efficiency.

- Agile Business Support: Execute high-priority tasks and specialized projects as assigned by leadership to address evolving business needs and organizational objectives.
WHAT WE WILL BE LOOKING FOR IN YOU:
- Experience: Minimum of 8–15 years in Supply Chain Management, with at least 4 years specifically leading S&OP, Production Planning, or Supply Chain Excellence initiatives within a regional role or an equivalent complex supply chain setting.

- Production Planning Expertise: Deep understanding of Master Production Scheduling (MPS) and shop-floor constraints; proven ability to bridge the gap between high-level regional demand and detailed factory execution.

- Regional Scope: Proven track record of managing complex, multi-country operations, ideally within ASEAN.

- Analytical Rigor: Advanced proficiency in data modeling and supply chain analytics tools.

- Strategic Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to distill complex supply chain data into actionable insights for C-suite executives while maintaining strong influence with local operational teams.

- Project Management: Demonstrated expertise in leading large-scale transformation projects; proficient in managing timelines, cross-functional resources, and change management to deliver digitalization or process optimization goals.

- Leadership: Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to drive consensus across diverse regional functions (Sales, Finance, and Manufacturing).

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, or Business. An MBA or professional certification (e.g., APICS CSCP/CPIM, PMP) is highly preferred.

jobs.title: Sales Manager Intelligent Labels
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated and highly driven new member as Sales Manager Intelligent Labels to join our team in the Avery Dennison Intelligent Labels Sales Team to boost RFID adoption across industries. In this position, you will work independently, either working from home or traveling to existing and new customers in the Eastern Europe region.
Key Responsibilities
This is a remote/hybrid position where you will work independently from home and travel to existing and new customers in your region.
- Grow and develop sales by winning new customers and expanding existing accounts across East Europe (Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Romania, Hungary, and Bulgaria).
- Execute results-oriented selling across the Avery Dennison RFID product portfolio, applying technical knowledge of RFID transponders and their use cases.
- Proactively build a robust sales pipeline, focusing on both new prospects and re-activating previous customers.
- Achieve sales and margin targets within the EMEA region while maintaining integrity to focus on the most rewarding requests and customers.
- Develop a sound understanding of the competitive landscape, continuously assessing trends, managing forecasts, and tracking activities in Salesforce.
Required:
- 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, ideally within an international business in the RFID industry or with highly technical products.
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills in English, both spoken and written, combined with a valid driving license.

Skills you need to succeed:
- Proven ability to manage complex projects, partnering effectively with internal departments (such as Business Development, Product Management, Customer Service, Quality, Credit/Finance, Supply Chain & Operations).
- Solution-oriented self-starter mindset with strong self-management, prioritization skills, and entrepreneurial thinking.
- Strong cultural empathy and team-player attitude with relationship-building skills to operate in a complex multinational organization.
What We Offer
Here's a glimpse of the great benefits you can expect:
- Health & Financial Benefits: Benefit from an annual medical check-up (1 day long), a monthly contribution to pension insurance 900 CZK, meal vouchers 180 CZK per day, 5 000 CZK vouchers (flexipass) annually and an Iphone for your personal use.
- Time Off: Enjoy 25 vacation days plus 3 sick days annually, and parental leave according to law.
- Flexible Work & Commute: *Benefit from a flexible work arrangement (Monday always in office, plus one additional day of your choice). *We offer free parking at the Distribution Center (industrial area) and a contribution for public transportation for those without company cars.
- Professional Development: We invest in your growth with individually set-up development plans with managers and language courses available for all, including our shop floor team.
- Well-being & On-site Perks: Access to Lyra, our confidential Employee Assistance Program, for personal and professional support. You'll also receive meal vouchers, and enjoy free coffee/tea at the workplace. We offer vouchers for culture/pharmacy and a multisport card.

Why join Avery Dennison
We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. Our company designs and manufactures a wide variety of labeling and functional materials that enhance product packaging, carry information that improves the customer experience, and connect the physical and digital worlds. Learn more at www.averydennison.com .
At Avery Dennison, we work with the biggest brands in the FMCG, apparel, automotive, and pharma industries. Our Avery Dennison spol.s.r.o. location, founded in 1992, is a collaborative and dynamic environment that supports approximately 35 talented individuals. Key functions at this site include sales team, customer team, technical team, laboratory, HR, graphic division, credit service and DC operators, offering diverse career paths and opportunities for growth.
